name: 37919 · Knoxville, TN
findings: ZIP 37919 (Knoxville) has 189 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37919 (Knoxville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 37919 (Knoxville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 51 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
